title.value: Doctoral Scholarships for Candidates from the Global South - call 2027
title.evidence_quote: Special Research Fund - Doctoral Scholarships for Candidates from the Global South - call 2027

qualifications: Candidates must come from and hold the nationality of one of the selected Global South countries
Proposal submitted jointly by the candidate, a Ghent University supervisor and a supervisor at the partner university
Co-funding from the partner institution is mandatory
Exception requests (funding or mobility rules) due by 15 January 2027
description_short: Ghent University's Special Research Fund offers PhD "sandwich" scholarships for Global South candidates: 24 months funded within a 48-month PhD split between Ghent and a partner institution. About 15 scholarships yearly; earliest start 1 October 2027.

deadline.evidence_quote: The deadline for project proposals is 9 February 2027 at 23:59 (Belgian time)
